response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN s.gbsize END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN s.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), status_average AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scans, r.gb_per_minute, r.gb_per_minute - a.avg_gb_per_minute AS exceeds_average_by FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN status_average AS a WHERE r.gb_per_minute > a.avg_gb_per_minute

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute for a status means total GB divided by total minutes, using only rows with both values present. The average across statuses gives each status equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: GB per minute for each status is the average of its individual scans' GB-per-minute rates.
